intro: Saltspray Glen is a windswept expanse in the northwestern Wetlands hugging the shores of Baradin Bay. Strong coastal gales regularly fling briny seawater across the mossy lowland, which is overrun by aggressive wild raptors. It forms a treacherous natural corridor between neighboring murloc-infested marshes and ancient dwarven ruins.

p: Tucked away in the far northwestern reach of the Wetlands, Saltspray Glen takes its name from the sea spray driven inland off Baradin Bay whenever coastal gales kick up. Bordered by the murloc-haunted waters of Bluegill Marsh to the south and the quiet bluffs of Ironbeard's Tomb to the east, the glen offers little comfort to passing travelers. Packs of cunning wild raptors nest throughout the marshy grass, hunting along the brackish flats alongside their kin from nearby Raptor Ridge and Black Channel Marsh.
